items.q: How does selective filtering actually work?
items.a: Honest Science™, in plain words: our E-Guard Retina™ and E-Guard Circadian™ lenses act only on the specific wavelengths of visible light involved in digital eye strain and evening exposure — while letting the rest of the spectrum pass through, so you keep seeing colors as they are. It is not a tinted lens and not a filter over reality. We describe what the lens does optically, not how you should feel wearing it.

items.q: Who are Eyegis glasses designed for?
items.a: Anyone who spends meaningful time in front of screens — working, studying, creating, gaming, streaming or scrolling. Eyegis is built around different lifestyles and levels of digital exposure, from focused daytime hours (E-Guard Retina™) to late-evening use before sleep (E-Guard Circadian™).

EN.title: Declaration of Compliance
EN.intro: This page is maintained by the Eyegis team to explain the standards our lenses are engineered and tested against, and the scope of our compliance statements.

sections.p: Every Eyegis lens design is engineered and independently laboratory-tested against internationally recognized standards: ANSI Z80.3 (United States) for non-prescription sunglass and fashion eyewear, EN ISO 12312-1 (Europe) for sunglasses and general-use eyewear, and AS/NZS 1067.1 (Australia & New Zealand).

Independent laboratory verification covers full spectral transmission (280–780 nm), UV protection, Visible Light Transmission (Tv), color fidelity — including Traffic Signal Recognition (Tsig) for accurate red/yellow/green perception — and mechanical robustness of the frame.

Our E-Guard Retina™ and E-Guard Circadian™ scores are proprietary indicators derived from the measured transmission spectrum. They are inspired by scientific literature (CIE, ICNIRP, ANSI) and are not medical certifications and should not be interpreted as medical claims.
Products distributed through Amazon marketplaces follow the local conformity, labelling and consumer-information requirements of each destination country.

EN.note: This declaration is provided for information purposes. Full test reports are available to distribution partners and regulators upon request.

PT.title: Declaração de Conformidade
PT.intro: Esta página é mantida pela equipe Eyegis para explicar os padrões contra os quais as nossas lentes são projetadas e testadas, bem como o escopo das nossas declarações de conformidade.

sections.p: Cada lente Eyegis é projetada e testada de forma independente em laboratório frente a padrões internacionalmente reconhecidos: ANSI Z80.3 (Estados Unidos) para eyewear de moda e não corretivo, EN ISO 12312-1 (Europa) para óculos de sol e uso geral, e AS/NZS 1067.1 (Austrália e Nova Zelândia).

A verificação laboratorial independente abrange transmissão espectral completa (280–780 nm), proteção UV, Transmissão de Luz Visível (Tv), fidelidade cromática — incluindo Reconhecimento de Sinais de Trânsito (Tsig) para percepção precisa de vermelho/amarelo/verde — e a resistência mecânica da armação.

Os nossos scores E-Guard Retina™ e E-Guard Circadian™ são indicadores proprietários derivados do espectro de transmissão medido. São inspirados na literatura científica (CIE, ICNIRP, ANSI) e não constituem certificações médicas nem devem ser interpretados como alegações médicas.
Os produtos distribuídos por marketplaces Amazon seguem as exigências locais de conformidade, rotulagem e informação ao consumidor de cada país de destino.

PT.note: Esta declaração é fornecida para fins informativos. Os relatórios completos de teste estão disponíveis para parceiros distribuidores e autoridades reguladoras mediante solicitação.

FR.title: Déclaration de Conformité
FR.intro: Cette page est maintenue par l'équipe Eyegis pour expliquer les normes selon lesquelles nos verres sont conçus et testés, ainsi que la portée de nos déclarations de conformité.

sections.p: Chaque verre Eyegis est conçu et testé de manière indépendante en laboratoire selon des normes internationalement reconnues : ANSI Z80.3 (États-Unis) pour les lunettes non correctrices et de mode, EN ISO 12312-1 (Europe) pour les lunettes de soleil et à usage général, et AS/NZS 1067.1 (Australie et Nouvelle-Zélande).

La vérification laboratoire indépendante couvre la transmission spectrale complète (280–780 nm), la protection UV, la Transmission de la Lumière Visible (Tv), la fidélité chromatique — incluant la Reconnaissance des Signaux de Circulation (Tsig) pour une perception fidèle du rouge/jaune/vert — et la robustesse mécanique de la monture.

Nos scores E-Guard Retina™ et E-Guard Circadian™ sont des indicateurs propriétaires dérivés du spectre de transmission mesuré. Ils s'inspirent de la littérature scientifique (CIE, ICNIRP, ANSI) et ne constituent pas des certifications médicales et ne doivent pas être interprétés comme des allégations médicales.
Les produits distribués via les marketplaces Amazon respectent les exigences locales de conformité, d'étiquetage et d'information consommateur de chaque pays de destination.

FR.note: Cette déclaration est fournie à titre informatif. Les rapports de test complets sont disponibles pour les partenaires distributeurs et les autorités de régulation sur demande.

belief.p1: Modern life has changed. We work, study, create, communicate and play — almost entirely through digital devices. Yet the objects designed to protect our eyes still feel like an afterthought.
belief.p2: Eyegis believes visual comfort should be part of everyday life — not a medical accessory, not a gimmick. Simply a beautifully engineered object you'd want to wear anyway.

why.h1: Digital lifestyles have changed. Eyewear hasn't.
why.p1: We spend eight to twelve hours a day in front of screens — phones, laptops, monitors, tablets, consoles. And still, most blue-light eyewear feels stuck in another decade.
why.p2: Most blue-light glasses either look overly technical — or make exaggerated promises they can't measure. Eyegis was created to bridge that gap: honest optical engineering, expressed through timeless design.

belief.p2: Eyegis pense que le confort visuel doit faire partie de la vie quotidienne — pas un accessoire médical, pas un gadget. Simplement un objet magnifiquement conçu, que l'on a envie de porter.

why.alt1: Les écrans entourent la vie moderne
why.h1: Les vies numériques ont changé. Pas les lunettes.
why.p1: Nous passons huit à douze heures par jour devant des écrans — téléphones, ordinateurs, moniteurs, tablettes, consoles. Et pourtant, la plupart des lunettes anti-lumière bleue semblent figées dans une autre décennie.
why.p2: La plupart des lunettes anti-lumière bleue paraissent trop techniques — ou multiplient les promesses invérifiables. Eyegis a été créée pour combler ce fossé : une ingénierie optique honnête, portée par un design intemporel.

hero.title: The science behind the lenses.
hero.body: The blue-light market is filled with confusion, exaggerated claims and misleading numbers. Our goal is simple: explain what we know, what we don't know and how our lenses are engineered.

spectrum.label: Spectrum
spectrum.title: Blue light is not
spectrum.body: Blue light is often marketed as one specific threat. In reality, it spans a broad spectrum of visible wavelengths between 380 and 500 nanometers. Think of it like UV light: it is a category, not a single wavelength.

mechanisms.label: Two mechanisms
mechanisms.title: Retina vs Circadian.

retina.title: Photobiological hazard
retina.body: Research on photobiological hazards identifies a peak sensitivity in the blue-violet region, around 435–440 nm.

circadian.title: Biological clock
circadian.body: The body's internal clock is most sensitive to slightly longer blue wavelengths, centered around roughly 480 nm.

mechanisms.closing: Because the biological mechanisms and wavelengths are different, Eyegis targets them as

selective.label: Selective filtering
selective.title: Why selective filtering
paragraphs: Many brands advertise a single, catch-all number: Blocks 40%, Blocks 60% or Blocks 90%. These metrics are highly misleading because they depend entirely on which wavelengths are included in the math.

A lens could block large amounts of relatively less relevant wavelengths while allowing much of the critical range to pass through. The cornea already filters close to 100% of blue light at the lowest wavelengths, around 380–400 nm.
selective.closing: Eyegis measures performance where it actually matters, not where it inflates a marketing claim.

color.label: Color fidelity
color.title: Why heavy orange lenses
color.body: When a lens aggressively strips away all blue light, color accuracy vanishes.
color.closing: For some applications, that trade-off may be acceptable. For many users, it is not.

scores.label: E-Guard Scores
scores.title: Understanding
scores.body: The E-Guard Retina and E-Guard Circadian scores are proprietary Eyegis indicators. They are inspired by published scientific literature, including work from the CIE and research on circadian light exposure.
scores.notice: They are not medical certifications and should not be interpreted as medical claims.

hero.title: A ciência por trás das lentes.
hero.body: O mercado de luz azul está cheio de confusão, alegações exageradas e números enganosos. Nosso objetivo é simples: explicar o que sabemos, o que ainda não sabemos e como nossas lentes são projetadas.

spectrum.label: Espectro
spectrum.title: A luz azul não é
spectrum.body: A luz azul costuma ser divulgada como uma ameaça única. Na realidade, ela ocupa uma ampla faixa do espectro visível entre 380 e 500 nanômetros. Pense nela como a luz UV: é uma categoria, não um único comprimento de onda.

mechanisms.label: Dois mecanismos
mechanisms.title: Retina vs Circadiano.

retina.title: Risco fotobiológico
retina.body: Pesquisas sobre riscos fotobiológicos identificam um pico de sensibilidade na região azul-violeta, em torno de 435–440 nm.

circadian.title: Relógio biológico
circadian.body: O relógio interno do corpo é mais sensível a comprimentos de onda azuis um pouco mais longos, centrados aproximadamente em 480 nm.

mechanisms.closing: Como os mecanismos biológicos e os comprimentos de onda são diferentes, a Eyegis trata como

selective.label: Filtragem seletiva
selective.title: Por que a filtragem seletiva
paragraphs: Muitas marcas divulgam um único número genérico: Bloqueia 40%, 60% ou 90%. Essas métricas podem enganar porque dependem totalmente dos comprimentos de onda incluídos no cálculo.

Uma lente pode bloquear grandes quantidades de faixas menos relevantes e deixar passar boa parte da faixa crítica. A própria córnea já filtra quase 100% da luz azul nos comprimentos mais baixos, por volta de 380–400 nm.
selective.closing: A Eyegis mede o desempenho onde realmente importa, não onde um número aumenta uma alegação de marketing.

color.label: Fidelidade de cor
color.title: Por que lentes muito alaranjadas
color.body: Quando uma lente remove agressivamente toda a luz azul, a precisão das cores desaparece.
color.closing: Em algumas aplicações, essa troca pode ser aceitável. Para muitos usuários, não é.

scores.title: Entendendo os
scores.body: Os scores E-Guard Retina e E-Guard Circadian são indicadores proprietários da Eyegis. Eles se inspiram em literatura científica publicada, incluindo trabalhos da CIE e pesquisas sobre exposição circadiana à luz.
scores.notice: Eles não são certificações médicas e não devem ser interpretados como alegações médicas.

hero.title: La science derrière les verres.
hero.body: Le marché de la lumière bleue est rempli de confusion, d'affirmations exagérées et de chiffres trompeurs. Notre objectif est simple : expliquer ce que nous savons, ce que nous ignorons encore et comment nos verres sont conçus.

spectrum.label: Spectre
spectrum.title: La lumière bleue n'est pas
spectrum.body: La lumière bleue est souvent présentée comme une menace unique. En réalité, elle couvre une large partie du spectre visible entre 380 et 500 nanomètres. Comme les UV, c'est une catégorie et non une longueur d'onde unique.

mechanisms.label: Deux mécanismes
mechanisms.title: Rétine vs Circadien.

retina.title: Risque photobiologique
retina.body: Les recherches sur les risques photobiologiques identifient un pic de sensibilité dans la région bleu-violet, autour de 435–440 nm.

circadian.title: Horloge biologique
circadian.body: L'horloge interne du corps est plus sensible aux longueurs d'onde bleues légèrement plus longues, centrées autour de 480 nm.

mechanisms.closing: Les mécanismes biologiques et les longueurs d'onde étant différents, Eyegis les traite comme

selective.label: Filtrage sélectif
selective.title: Pourquoi le filtrage sélectif
paragraphs: De nombreuses marques annoncent un chiffre unique : bloque 40 %, 60 % ou 90 %. Ces métriques peuvent être trompeuses, car elles dépendent entièrement des longueurs d'onde incluses dans le calcul.

Un verre peut bloquer de grandes quantités de longueurs d'onde moins pertinentes tout en laissant passer une partie de la plage critique. La cornée filtre déjà presque 100 % de la lumière bleue aux longueurs les plus basses, autour de 380–400 nm.
selective.closing: Eyegis mesure la performance là où elle compte vraiment, pas là où elle gonfle une promesse marketing.

color.label: Fidélité des couleurs
color.title: Pourquoi les verres très orangés
color.body: Lorsqu'un verre retire agressivement toute la lumière bleue, la précision des couleurs disparaît.
color.closing: Pour certaines applications, ce compromis peut être acceptable. Pour de nombreux utilisateurs, il ne l'est pas.

scores.label: Scores E-Guard
scores.title: Comprendre les
scores.body: Les scores E-Guard Retina et E-Guard Circadian sont des indicateurs propriétaires d'Eyegis. Ils s'inspirent de la littérature scientifique publiée, notamment des travaux de la CIE et des recherches sur l'exposition circadienne à la lumière.
scores.notice: Ils ne sont pas des certifications médicales et ne doivent pas être interprétés comme des allégations médicales.

circadian.description: L'exposition à la lumière bleue haute énergie après la tombée de la nuit peut perturber le cycle naturel du sommeil. E-Guard Circadian™ atténue ces longueurs d'onde du soir tout en maintenant une vision naturelle.

benefits.title: Couleurs naturelles

benefits.title: Routines nocturnes plus intelligentes
benefits.desc: Conçu pour le gaming, le travail, le streaming et la navigation tardive

why.title: Pourquoi les deux comptent.
why.lead: La plupart des lunettes traitent toute la lumière bleue comme si elle était identique. Chez Eyegis, nous distinguons deux défis.
